title: Add recency-weighted eviction
description: Replaces pure LFU with an exponential half-life decay on time since last access. Adds eviction_half_life_days config. Includes tests for tie-breaking by id and non-positive half-life.

title: Content-hash output dedup
description: Adds an output_hash column and index so identical content produced by different tools is deduped instead of re-stored.

title: Structure-aware fallback compression
description: Line-mode for multi-line output surfacing error/warn lines from the middle; block-mode otherwise. Needs a rebase; conflicts in generic.ts.

title: Import command for export dumps
description: Restore items from a recall__export JSON dump, skipping duplicates by id.

title: HTTP/SSE transport for learn
description: Connect to remote MCP servers over streamable HTTP with a legacy SSE fallback. Closed in favour of the SDK-based approach.

title: Split db module into focused files
description: Breaks db/index into queries, analytics, chunking, and types for readability. No behaviour change.

title: Add retrieval hints to the recall header
description: Extracts salient search terms from stored content and appends them to the summary header so the first recall__search lands on a real term.
